mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_records (user_id, route_name, mode, total_distance_m, total_duration_min, preferences) VALUES (#{userId}, #{routeName}, #{mode}, #{totalDistanceM}, #{totalDurationMin}, CAST(#{preferences} AS JSON))

INSERT INTO route_record_points (route_record_id, poi_id, point_name, sort_order, distance_from_start_m, description) VALUES (#{routeRecordId}, #{poiId}, #{pointName}, #{sortOrder}, #{distanceFromStartM}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT id, route_name AS routeName, mode, total_distance_m AS totalDistanceM, total_duration_min AS totalDurationMin, preferences, created_at AS createdAt FROM route_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, route_name AS routeName, mode, total_distance_m AS totalDistanceM, total_duration_min AS totalDurationMin, preferences, created_at AS createdAt FROM route_records WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, poi_id AS poiId, point_name AS pointName, sort_order AS sortOrder, distance_from_start_m AS distanceFromStartM, description FROM route_record_points WHERE route_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
